reviews.title: Good concept, but tries too hard
reviews.text: The concept is cool.  Maybe I didn’t give it enough of a chance.  Me personally, it felt like they were going for Skyrim but with more realism.  But the focus on realism isn’t real itself.  Because my guy is hungry and thirsty all the time.  But i played for less the 30 minutes.  Now if you’re using accelerated timelines, OK, but gathering and such is not accelerated.  So, the timing is a mismatch.  I barely gather anything and i have to feed the dude.  I appreciate not having an unlimited storage capacity on one hand, but hate it at the same time. I want entertainment too.  I don’t have time to live a second full time life virtually.  And a struggling one at that.  The “realism” isn’t real and exaggerated.  I can appreciate the attempt on one hand but delete due to boredom and monotony on the other.

reviews.title: Expensive garbage
reviews.text: This game is a ridiculous waste of time. It’s set up so that simple tasks take forever to complete and you have to buy expensive gear to carry resources. I paid $10 for a bag to hold supplies, got killed, and my $10 bag disappeared. Don’t waste your time or money on this game.

reviews.title: Fun Game!
reviews.text:
This game is really fun! It hooks you and reels you in whole heartedly. 
It is also out to kill you without paying for the good gear/equipment/accessories…
If you wish to go the pay-to-play route then yeah, it will be waaaaay less frustrating. 
When you get the “Backpack” don’t equip it in dungeons, YOU WILL DIE; and there goes your really cool backpack. 
Use the BACKPACK only for gathering materials and simple areas, NOT dungeons; it will be GONE never to be seen again lol. 
The do overs are cool though IF you want to try for that big ole backpack again and again…I have lol. 
BUT, I do really like this game. I am 60 and it gives me pleasure day in and day out. 
If the game were explained a little bit better and everything wasn’t out to kill you every second of the game I would actually give it 5 stars. But I think 4 stars is fair.

reviews.title: Early stages are fun, later stages not so much
reviews.text:
This starts out a pretty reasonable survival game-bit of a learning curve, but fun. However, now I’m level 22. (Update: now level 35–no change) The stage one areas are boring and have been for a while. Not that they are easy, but they are the same grind all the time. 

The stage 2 areas—and all side quest areas—I get one-shotted even with the best equipment I can make. Forget even trying a dungeon.

This is either way too high a power jump, or the game is trying force pay to play without saying so. Though from what I’ve read on other comments, paying doesn’t get you much further.

Controls are also really janky and the other “players” are actually bots programmed to show up out of nowhere while you are opening chests. They can have zero equipment and will still kill you in 2-3 hits, no matter what you are wearing for armor. In fact, I seem to die faster if I’m wearing better armor.

Most of the goals to earn XP at this stage are impossibly difficult without spending money. I wonder if “act 2” really even exists, because I’ve yet to see anyone advance to it.

In short this game is designed to kill you repeatedly and unfairly, prevent you from ever developing real resources and just a constant grind designed to make you pay to play.
